MAT	<p>e294_689b</p> <p>Match each of the following amino acids with their corresponding descriptions.</p><p><i>Note:</i> Each choice will be used exactly once.</p>	<span style="color: #833c8e;">tyrosine</span>	a <strong><span style="color: #b74300;">aromatic amino acid</span></strong> with a <strong><span style="color: #a719db;">side chain</span></strong> containing a phenol (-C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>6</sub>OH) group, derived from phenylalanine	<span style="color: #006a7a;">glutamic acid</span>	a <strong><span style="color: #d40000;">negatively charged amino acid</span></strong> with a large, carboxylate (-COOH) <strong><span style="color: #a719db;">side chain</span></strong>	<span style="color: #006e53;">aspartic acid</span>	a <strong><span style="color: #d40000;">negatively charged amino acid</span></strong> with a small, carboxylate (-COOH) <strong><span style="color: #a719db;">side chain</span></strong>	<span style="color: #9a3746;">alanine</span>	a <strong><span style="color: #6c6c00;">non-<strong><span style="color: #007a00;">polar amino acid</span></strong></span></strong>, with a single methyl group (-CH<sub>3</sub>) as its <strong><span style="color: #a719db;">side chain</span></strong>	<span style="color: #4951b6;">tryptophan</span>	an <strong><span style="color: #b74300;">aromatic amino acid</span></strong> with the largest <strong><span style="color: #a719db;">side chain</span></strong> consisting of a fused pair of rings
